rows.07:9f84:
...I was so appalled I couldn't say a word.
He really tried to kill me for a reason like that?
Just because some water splashed on his pants?
And it wasn't even on purpose. It was just an accident.
On top of that, I don't even remember whether it ever happened.
And yet he held a grudge over it and tried to kill me?
...Is this guy out of his mind?
A fresh wave of terror washed over me.
Do I really have to die for people like them?{p}
rows.07:a1f4: Maybe what I'd said earlier had set him off. Kazama showed no sign of dropping his defiant attitude.{p}What should I do?
rows.07:a280:
"...How'd you like to die?"
I was going to die soon.
I was going to die, all because of scum like them.
Why should I have to apologize to a guy like this?
"You told me to kill you a minute ago. Want me to kill you, just like you asked?
Even if you die, there are plenty of other ways to find the ampoule."
I tried to slam Kazama's head into the cabinet again.
This time into the other cabinet, the one with its glass still intact...
"...Stop! I'm sorry! I'll tell you anything!"
Kazama shrieked, his voice cracking.
"You should've said that from the start. Where's the ampoule?"
"...Th-that's something only Hino knows."
"You want to die?"
"It's true! It really is! I really don't know!"
It looked like he truly didn't know.
...If I believed what he said, my only options were to search for the ampoule or to ask Hino directly.
There was no point in going after any of the others.{p}What should I do?
rows.07:a96c:
The cabinets were full of paintings, apparently done by art club students.
Of course the ampoule wouldn't be in a place like this.{p}
rows.07:ac60:
All the same, I went into the pitch-dark old school building.
...It was no use.
There was no way I could even tell left from right.
...I'd better give up.{p}
rows.07:c01c:
The newspaper club room☆
That's right, it might be there.
It was the last place I'd ever think to search.
Hino being Hino, I was sure of it.
He'd be out to outsmart me, no doubt.
...Was anyone still left in the newspaper club room?
No, judging from the situation, they were all out looking for me.
Were they enjoying themselves, playing at some kind of manhunt?{p}
rows.07:c4cc:
...So that was it.
She'd been startled by the portrait of Iwashita I was holding.
I hurriedly pulled the rope off my neck and reached for the portrait.{p}What should I do?
rows.07:c8b8:
"Eeeeeeeek!☆"
Iwashita screamed at the very instant Arai slashed the portrait.{p}
rows.07:c920:
"I'll kill you!"
Then, her face twisted with rage, Iwashita attacked.
...Not me, but Arai.
Arai can't have seen that coming.
As the two of them grappled, the chisel ended up in Iwashita's hand.
"Die! Die! Drop dead!"{p}
rows.07:d108:
On the notebook were the words "Notebook of Grudges."{p}...What is this?
Should I read it?
rows.07:d3c4:
Yo, {a}.
I figured you'd come back to the newspaper club, so I'm leaving this notebook on the shelf for you.
If you find it, read it carefully.
These are the sinners we've killed so far.
There are many reasons why you're going to be killed.
You've committed crimes that would justify the death penalty.
The charges are as follows.{p}
rows.07:dba0:
...In the art room, Kazama was dead.
"...My God."
My knees buckled, and a sigh escaped my lips.
Kazama's head lay tossed carelessly aside, and on the floor, written in blood, were the words:
Death to the losers!
...Did Hino kill him?{p}
rows.07:dcf0:
...The old school building.
Even in the state I was in, the old school building still scared me.
There was no electricity in the old school building, so without a flashlight, there was no way I could search it.
Luckily, I had the flashlight I'd picked up in the night-duty room.
But searching a building this huge without a single clue was next to impossible.
I gave up and decided to go somewhere else.{p}
rows.07:de50:
I decided to go to the nurse's office.
If you're going to hide medicine, you hide it with other medicine.
That's just common sense.
I hurried to the nurse's office.{p}
rows.07:e1f4:
Flinging the bed aside, Hosoda emerged from behind it.
Oh no.
I should have checked the bed!
His huge body quaking, he charged at me.{p}
